palette.primary_role: Dark near-black for text and dark surfaces. IBM uses Gray 100 (#161616) — not pure black, a warmer dark. Cisco recommends charcoal-navy blends (#0f1720 to #1b2530). Enterprise uses deep teal-black (#072c2c). White (#ffffff) for light surfaces. Enterprise brands tint their 'black' toward their brand color.
palette.accent_role: Single high-signal blue as the primary interactive color. IBM Blue 60 (#0f62fe) — the one blue to rule them all. Cisco Blue (#049fd9) — bright, electric trust signal. Enterprise uses orange (#ff5f03) as a secondary accent against dark teal. Blue is the enterprise trust color across the board.
palette.surface_role: White and gray layered surfaces for information hierarchy. IBM uses Gray 10 (#f4f4f4) for elevated cards — background-color layering instead of shadows. Cisco uses Dark Gray (#39393b) for dark-theme cards. Enterprise uses warm off-white (#edeade).
palette.neutral_role: Gray scale from dark to light for text hierarchy, borders, and disabled states. IBM's Gray 70 (#525252) for secondary text. Cisco's Medium Gray 2 (#9e9ea2) for muted labels. Enterprise uses standard gray scale.
palette.border_role: Subtle borders for data-heavy interfaces. IBM uses Gray 30 (#c6c6c6) for standard borders and bottom-border inputs. Cisco uses Dark Gray 2 (#58585b) for dark-theme borders. Borders are functional, never decorative.

border_radius.sharp: 0px (buttons, cards, inputs — the Carbon signature, the enterprise default)
border_radius.pill: 24px (tags/labels only — the sole rounded exception in IBM Carbon)
border_radius.typical_button: 0px — sharp rectangle is the enterprise identity (IBM, Cisco, Enterprise)
border_radius.typical_card: 0px - 16px (IBM tiles at 0px, Cisco cards at 16-20px for dark theme)

button_styles.text: Get started, Contact sales, Learn more, Deploy now
Secondary actions on dark Cisco surfaces

elevation.shadows: shadow-averse — depth from background-color layering, not simulated light
elevation.approach: IBM Carbon is deliberately shadow-averse — depth achieved through progressively darker surface grays (white -> #f4f4f4 -> #e0e0e0). Cisco uses minimal shadow on dark surfaces, with surface contrast for depth. Enterprise uses standard minimal elevation. Shadows are reserved for floating elements (dropdowns, tooltips, modals) where genuine overlap occurs.

typical_order: header (dark masthead 48px tall, logo left, horizontal nav links, search trigger right)
hero (white or dark bg, 60px IBM Plex Sans weight 300, left-aligned headline, blue CTA with arrow icon, product illustration right)
content_blocks (alternating white/gray-10 background bands, each a self-contained statement — headline + body + CTA + image)
tile_grid (clickable card grid on gray-10 bg, 0px radius, background-shift hover, arrow icon reveal)
data_statistics (large numbers in light display weight, supporting captions, minimal decoration)
product_modules (dashboard screenshots, network diagrams, data visualizations with brand-blue highlights)
customer_logos (enterprise client logos in grayscale, 'Trusted by' headline)
case_studies (metric-driven, problem-solution-results format, client industry tags)
cta (full-width blue or dark section, centered, primary rectangular CTA)
footer (dark Gray 100 bg, white/gray text, multi-column: product, solutions, support, company, legal + copyright)
hero_variants: light_display (IBM style — white bg, 60px IBM Plex Sans weight 300, line-height 1.17, Gray 100 text, blue rectangular CTA)
dark_infrastructure (Cisco style — dark navy-charcoal bg, 72px CiscoSansTT weight 500, white text, Cisco Blue signal CTA)
clean_structured (Enterprise style — #edeade warm surface, #072c2c dark text, clean hierarchy, data-driven layout)
feature_card_variants: tile (gray-10 bg, 0px radius, 16px padding, title + description + arrow icon on hover — IBM signature)
dashboard_card (dark bg, subtle border, white text, blue chart highlights, metric + sparkline — Cisco signature)
data_module (dense information card, compact spacing, clear hierarchy, blue accent for key metrics)
case_study_card (client logo + quote + metric outcome, structured layout)

tone_profile.headline_style: platform positioning, outcome-oriented, 4-8 words (e.g., 'AI for business. AI for the world.', 'The bridge between possible and practical', 'Infrastructure that scales with you')
tone_profile.cta_style: professional and direct (Contact sales, Talk to an expert, Get started, Deploy now, Explore solutions — enterprise buyers research before committing)

color_mood: carbon_blue (IBM: #ffffff canvas, #161616 text, #0f62fe lone accent, #f4f4f4 surfaces — structured monochrome + one blue)
dark_infrastructure (Cisco: #0f1720 to #1b2530 charcoal-navy canvas, #049fd9 electric blue signal, white text — serious global platform)
clean_teal (Enterprise: #edeade warm off-white canvas, #072c2c deep teal text, #ff5f03 orange accent pop — structured but approachable)
typography_mood: carbon_light_display (IBM: IBM Plex Sans weight 300 at display sizes, 0.16px letter-spacing at 14px, 0.32px at 12px — micro-tracking precision)
infrastructure_decisive (Cisco: CiscoSansTT weight 500, compressed display tracking, practical body copy — platform authority)
enterprise_expressive (Enterprise: Oswald display for headlines, Ubuntu for body — distinctive but professional)
layout_density: productive_dense (IBM Carbon: tight sections, 48px rhythm, background-color alternation for visual separation — enterprise information density)
dark_spacious (Cisco: large dark fields with one blue focal point, generous spacing between data modules, cinematic restraint)
clean_balanced (Enterprise: comfortable density, clear content blocks, obvious hierarchy)

solutions_page.best_practices: Industry-specific solution cards, role-based navigation (by industry, by challenge, by technology), case study links with client logos

product_page.best_practices: Architecture diagrams, technical specifications, API documentation links, enterprise feature comparison, 'Talk to sales' for pricing

docs_page.best_practices: Structured documentation with code blocks in IBM Plex Mono, API reference tables, version selectors, search with autocomplete
